concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-us-tax-forms]] — 2026-09-15 US direct-payout 1099-K filing-scope and platform retrieval/PDF-delivery guide with tax-year-specific threshold and roles; title also mentions 1099-NEC but body details only 1099-K, and instructions do not prove filing or delivery.
warnings: The title/description mention 1099-NEC but the body only specifies 1099-K criteria and procedure.
The USD 20,000 and 200-transaction threshold is explicitly for tax year 2025; state rules may vary and current law must be verified before tax decisions.
Generation, API retrieval, user consent and PDF delivery are distinct events.
